title: The Last Static Again
author: Mara Eastwick
blurb: Ivo Underhill, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
